effects.effect: Whenever you use the [Charge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/charge) main action, you can use a [strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike) [signature ability](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/signature-ability) or a [strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike) [heroic ability](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/heroic-ability) instead of a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike). Additionally, you can jump as part of your charge.
